description: A distressed-assets committee chair must authorize a binding bid for a portfolio of non-performing loans and finalize the eligible pool, maximum bid, cash reserve, and related-party controls, with input from credit risk, loan operations, and compliance.

shared_context.S1: The bank is considering a binding bid for a portfolio of non-performing loans with a stated face balance of $12,000,000.
shared_context.S2: The seller's draft process invites bids by Friday, and the preliminary internal worksheet shows an $8,000,000 bid for the full stated portfolio.
shared_context.S3: Mara has authority to approve the bank's bid and its final transaction conditions.
shared_context.S4: As part of the bank's routine pre-bid process, Mara obtains sign-off from credit risk, loan operations, and compliance before submitting a binding bid.

PF1.text: While refreshing the recovery model this morning, Jonas confirmed that the risk limit permits a maximum bid of exactly $7,400,000 for this pool and requires a cash reserve equal to exactly 25% of that bid; the revised model has not yet been attached to the committee worksheet.

PF2.text: Elena found in the servicing files this week that one $1,100,000 loan in the stated pool is subject to a borrower-consent restriction that prevents assignment in this transaction, so the eligible transferred face balance must be exactly $10,900,000; operations has not yet updated the seller's tape.

PF3.text: Ravi confirmed in a compliance memo received this morning that the seller is an affiliated entity, so the bid package must include a related-party disclosure and an independent valuation before submission; he has not yet circulated the memo.

acceptance_conditions: The binding bid must not yet be approved because the required sign-offs and transaction documents are not yet complete.
The eligible transferred face balance must be exactly $10,900,000.
The maximum bid must be exactly $7,400,000.
The cash reserve must be exactly $1,850,000.
A related-party disclosure must be required.
An independent valuation must be required before submission.
The settlement must include a condition-precedent or conditional-approval commitment that withholds submission until the required conditions are completed.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'condition_precedent' or c['type'] == 'conditional_approval' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The worksheet's apparent $8,000,000 full-pool bid has no verified risk limit, reserve, or credit condition precedent, while PF1 changes maximum_bid_usd to exactly $7,400,000, cash_reserve_usd to exactly $1,850,000, and requires withholding submission until those credit conditions are documented.
The public tape presents a $12,000,000 face balance, while PF2 removes the restricted $1,100,000 loan and changes eligible_transferred_face_balance_usd to exactly $10,900,000.
The public bid worksheet contains neither special-party disclosure nor valuation controls, while PF3 changes related_party_disclosure_required and independent_valuation_required to true.
